Generated from runtime JSON Schema by `npm run docs:generate`. Field descriptions include inherited fields. required means the field must be present; whether null is allowed depends on type/combined constraints. See each page’s linked Schema for full conditional constraints.

These are internal persistence/domain contracts; see [API v1](../api/v1/README.md) for client DTOs. Schema is the source of structural validation; TypeScript contracts.ts contains generated types. See [data model](../data-model.md) and [states and scheduling](../state-machines.md) for usage.

Store.shape validates all persisted records. Ordinary requests and nested definitions are validated by call-site shape/shapeDefinition or host logic. `record_type + id` locates records; revision checks versions; ObjectRef references immutable originals by SHA-256.

Runtime source: [contracts.schema.json](../../../src/contracts/contracts.schema.json), [contracts.ts](../../../src/pi_secretary/src/contracts.ts), [Store](../../../src/pi_secretary/src/store.ts).
